sentences.en: The surface of the earth rose due to the volcanic activity.
sentences.zh: 由于火山活动，地球表面升高了。

sentences.en: Mount Etna has erupted, showering Sicily in volcanic rock.
sentences.zh: 埃特纳火山爆发，向西西里岛撒下了火山岩。

sentences.en: Volcanic eruptions in Tonga have created a new island.
sentences.zh: 汤加的火山喷发创造了一个新的岛屿。

senses.zh: 火山的，火山引发的；（感情或情绪）猛烈的，易突然发作的
